Medinīkara
--Tiṅantavyākaraṇa. Bṛhatsūcī, Nepal VI. p. 23 (2 mss.).

Medinīkara
(A. D. 1200-75), son of Prāṇakara (a. of Ṣaṭśatagāthākośa) a ruler of the Northern provinces of the Orissa Kings of Gaṅga dynasty; the capital was changed by Medinīkara from a. inland town to a place on the Kasāi, still known in Bengal a. Medinīpur.
--Medinīkośa or Nānārthaśabdakośa or Anekārthakośa. qs. Śubhāṅga, Ratnamālā, Dharma. See below.
Mentioned by Kāyastha Gopāladāsa in his C. Śabdāmṛta on Kumārasaṃbhava of Kālidāsa. Refer BORI. D. XIII. i. 135.
